floor_history.headline: Recon: floor=9 reconfirmed on pin-free candidate; m2c shows target reconstructs WITHOUT a load-temp (direct inlined stores) and WITHOUT the v1 pointer alias — an untried structural shape; sibling func

Structural sweep (13 forms). Floor held at 9; killed 8 named structural levers; walking-pointer lowers score to 7 but adds an insn so it's architecturally blocked from match — proves the RA tiebreak I
s3 structural sweep lowered pin-free floor 9 -> 6 via mask atomically-first post-call (V7); pre-call proven byte-identical to target so pre-call-freelist hypothesis KILLED.

Permuter reseeded from interleaved-V0 target-shape (fresh basin, not prior s4's V7 seed): no cheat-free sub-6 form; sub-6 finds all coercion-gated (output-30-1 sandbox 5 cheat-reviewer FAIL). Floor ho

s5 directed permuter (PERM_LINESWAP+RANDOMIZE, pre-call frozen): no cheat-free sub-6, but reached sandbox 2 (closest ever) via an invented-var stage that reproduces target's exact load=$v0/mask=$v1 la
Forensics: v0<->v1 wall traced to local-alloc.c:472 reg_n_deaths==1 gate; reused load-temp (3 deaths) punted to global, single-death mask grabs v0 locally first. Flip needs a fresh single-death local

s7 forensics: both live-frontier RA axes + a new aggregate-copy axis KILLED with cc1 -da; v0<->v1 wall is a local-before-global pass-ordering invariant at 43 insns. Every sanctioned axis dead across 4

Opened the last unprobed local-alloc input (find_free_reg's conflict set): hard-reg liveness DOES evict the 0xFFFFEF mask off $v0 without any invented local -- but it necessarily evicts the load web t

frontier.hypothesis: The wall is now fully characterised on the LOCAL-alloc side (all three inputs to the mask's register choice measured dead), so the only untried surface is the GLOBAL side: making global-alloc's allocno ordering hand the web $v0 BEFORE local-alloc runs is impossible by pass order, but global.c's set_preference / reg_preferred_class path for the web has never been probed for a construct that makes the web's preferred class exclude $v1 (which would force a different resolution rather than the silent fallback).
frontier.mechanism: global.c set_preference records hard-reg copy preferences per allocno; reg_preferred_class comes from regclass.c's cost model. A web whose preferred class excluded $v1 would have to be resolved by reload rather than by the silent lowest-free fallback, potentially with a different register choice.
frontier.next_probe: Dump .regclass/.greg for FORM F and read the web allocno's preferred/alternate class and its recorded preferences; then look for any pure-C construct (pointer type, sub-word access, address arithmetic) that changes the web's preferred class without changing insn count.

frontier.hypothesis: A whole-function structural idiom other than the reused-temp + interleaved-mask topology that all nine sessions have assumed could produce target's 43 insns with a different pseudo/quantity decomposition entirely.
frontier.mechanism: Every form measured so far starts from m2c's reused-temp reconstruction; the RA outcome is a function of that decomposition, not of the target bytes per se.
frontier.next_probe: Re-derive the function from the bytes with a deliberately different decomposition (e.g. the three stores expressed through a single walking destination pointer paired with a single walking source pointer -- distinct from s2's walking-pointer form, which walked only the source and cost +1 insn), then dump .lreg to see whether the mask's live range stops being a subinterval of the web's.

frontier.hypothesis: The sibling cluster (func_80061658 / func_80061710 / func_800617C8 / func_80061250, same file, same $2/$3 shape) shares this exact containment invariant, so a solution found for any one of them transfers to all.
frontier.mechanism: All carry the same reused-load-web + interleaved-constant-mask topology and the same local-before-global pass-ordering resolution.
frontier.next_probe: Check whether any sibling's target has the mask live range NOT contained in the web's (i.e. mask store after the last web store). Such a sibling would be solvable by the FORM I conflict-set lever and would supply a transferable idiom.
